# 5-Day Singapore Business Trip Plan

A compact solo business itinerary for **2026-07-06 to 2026-07-10** that keeps you near an **MRT station**, reserves **2 hours of work time each evening**, and stays within a **2,400 SGD total budget excluding airfare**.

## Trip Schedule and Daily Spend

| Day | Focus | Schedule Highlights | Estimated Daily Spend |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jul 6 | Arrival + setup | Arrive, check in near MRT, light lunch, client prep, evening work block, low-cost dinner | **SGD 260** |
| Jul 7 | Meetings day | Breakfast, meetings, lunch near CBD, afternoon follow-ups, evening work block, low-cost dinner | **SGD 310** |
| Jul 8 | Networking dinner | Meetings/follow-ups, daytime buffer, evening work block, **networking dinner** | **SGD 420** |
| Jul 9 | Execution day | Breakfast, core meetings, admin time, evening work block, low-cost dinner | **SGD 300** |
| Jul 10 | Wrap-up + departure | Final checkouts, last meetings, airport transfer, snack/lunch | **SGD 220** |

## Day-by-Day Business Plan

### Day 1: Monday, 2026-07-06 — Arrival and Work Setup
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Arrive in Singapore, take MRT or taxi to hotel, check in, freshen up.
- Afternoon: Set up workspace, confirm meeting schedule, handle any urgent emails.
- Evening: **2 hours work time** in hotel lounge or room; keep dinner simple and nearby.
- Dinner: Hawker center meal or casual food court, around **SGD 12–18**.

### Day 2: Tuesday, 2026-07-07 — Core Meetings
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Breakfast near hotel, then first meeting block.
- Afternoon: Client visits or coworking/office sessions, short transit by MRT.
- Evening: **2 hours work time** for follow-ups, notes, and next-day prep.
- Dinner: Budget option at a hawker center or casual Asian diner, around **SGD 15–20**.

### Day 3: Wednesday, 2026-07-08 — Networking Dinner
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg
- Morning: Meetings or internal planning session.
- Afternoon: Free buffer for prep, calls, or a short reset break.
- Evening: **2 hours work time** before dinner.
- Dinner: **Networking dinner** at a mid-range restaurant near the CBD, around **SGD 70–120** per person.

### Day 4: Thursday, 2026-07-09 — Delivery and Follow-Up
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
- Morning: Breakfast and final business meetings.
- Afternoon: Follow-ups, document review, and any last-site visits.
- Evening: **2 hours work time** to close open items and send recap emails.
- Dinner: Low-cost option again, around **SGD 12–18**.

### Day 5: Friday, 2026-07-10 — Departure Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/airplane.svg
- Morning: Pack, check out, and complete any final calls.
- Afternoon: Airport transfer and departure.
- Evening: If needed, grab a light meal before flight or at the airport.

## Budget Breakdown for 5 Days

| Category | Estimated Total | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Hotel | **SGD 1,050** | Mid-range business hotel near an MRT station, about SGD 210/night |
| Local transport | **SGD 90** | MRT, occasional taxi/Grab, airport transfers |
| Meals | **SGD 420** | 4 low-cost dinners + breakfasts/lunches |
| Networking dinner | **SGD 100** | Mid-range dinner on Jul 8 |
| Coffee/snacks | **SGD 80** | Meeting days, hydration, small extras |
| Miscellaneous | **SGD 160** | Printing, SIM/top-up, contingency |
| Work/coworking | **SGD 120** | Optional meeting room or coworking use |
| Buffer | **SGD 380** | Keeps total under budget for changes |
| **Total** | **SGD 2,400** | Excludes airfare |

## Hotel Area Near MRT

Best practical zones for this trip:
- **Bugis**: central, strong MRT access, easy for meetings and dining.
- **Tanjong Pagar**: excellent for CBD access and networking dinners.
- **Lavender**: usually better value, still very convenient by MRT.
- **Novena**: good business base with easy transit and quieter evenings.

## Simple Packing List for Tropical Weather and Meetings

### Clothing
- 3–4 business shirts or blouses
- 2–3 trousers or skirts
- 1 lightweight blazer
- 1 smart-casual outfit for networking dinner
- 5 sets of underwear and socks
- Lightweight sleepwear

### Weather and Comfort
- Compact umbrella
- Breathable socks and moisture-wicking undershirts
- Small hand towel or tissue pack
- Refillable water bottle
- Sunscreen and lip balm

### Work Essentials
- Laptop and charger
- Phone charger and power bank
- USB-C or HDMI adapter if needed
- Notebook and pen
- Business cards
- Earbuds or headset for calls

### Travel Essentials
- Passport and travel documents
- Wallet with cards and some cash
- Any needed medications
- Small laundry bag
- Foldable tote for day use
